text: Implemented typed latent archive descriptors and plan opening: LatentArchiveDescriptor classifies explicit, temporal DCT, temporal Haar, shared-basis, transport, and BOLDZip archives; openDescriptor/maybeOpenDescriptor expose the descriptor surface; openPlan now materializes through the descriptor interpreter while preserving fromArchive compatibility. Added descriptor/plan assertions including Haar-as-explicit-response with TemporalHaar plan kind. Verification passed: sbt latentJVM/test latentJS/test (50 tests each) and git diff --check on reserved archive files.
